name: zsemle
description: Zsemle, a pixel-art companion above the prompt (golden retriever, cat, slime, paperclip): watches every usage limit (50/75/90% warnings, pace forecast, resets, API errors, automatic model switch and compaction, cost), stops work at 95%, guards file writes and cheers long turns. English and Hungarian, terminal and desktop.

language.title: Language / Nyelv
language.description: The language of every message: en (English) or hu (Hungarian).

skin.title: Figure / Figura
skin.description: The default figure, by its id: zsemle (dog), cirmi (cat), trutyi (slime), kapocs (paperclip), pingvin (penguin), teknos (turtle), horcsog (hamster), bagoly (owl), rubik (cube), gumikacsa (duck), bogre (mug), kaktusz (cactus), sarkany (dragon), szellem (ghost), robot. /zsemle skin <name> also switches it.

guardDashes.title: Block em and en dashes
guardDashes.description: The content guard also stops writes that add an em or en dash.

fatigueLook.title: Fatigue look
fatigueLook.description: The figure gets tired as the usage limit runs low and fresh again after a reset.

budgetPlanner.title: Weekly budget planner
budgetPlanner.description: Splits the weekly allowance into daily shares and warns in the evening when today went over.

modelAdvice.title: Model advice
modelAdvice.description: Suggests a smaller model when a simple task runs on a big one at a high limit.

contextSaver.title: Context saver
contextSaver.description: Above 70% context, asks the model for shorter answers and smaller file reads.

commitGuard.title: Commit guard
commitGuard.description: Stops a git commit once when no test ran since the last edit (repeat it to go ahead).

loopWatch.title: Loop watch
loopWatch.description: Speaks up when the model edits the same file a fifth time in one turn.

morningBrief.title: Morning brief
morningBrief.description: The first prompt of the day carries a short brief: yesterday's summary, waiting projects, the daily budget.

lessonSniff.title: Lesson sniff
lessonSniff.description: When the same error comes back a third time, suggests recording it as a lesson.

daySummary.title: Day summary
daySummary.description: When you sign off, asks for a short summary of the day and keeps it for the next morning.
